# 🌄 CrestMC

**CrestMC** is a community-focused Minecraft survival server built for players who enjoy classic survival with a modern multiplayer experience.

Build massive bases, create farms, trade with other players, and progress through a balanced economy — all while playing with an active community.

No complicated systems. No unfair advantages.  
Just **Minecraft survival the way it should feel.**

## ✨ Features

• Balanced Survival Economy  
• Player Trading & Shops  
• Crates & Rewards  
• Land Protection  
• Leaderboards  
• Community Events

## 🤝 Community

CrestMC is designed to be a **friendly place for players to build, explore, and enjoy survival together**.

Whether you're a builder, grinder, trader, or explorer — there's always something to do.
